projects.title: AI-Powered Jewelry Discovery Assistant
projects.tagline: A retailer-aware conversational experience for product discovery
projects.description: An AI-assisted jewelry discovery experience combining a chat interface with a Python backend, retrieval-based knowledge, and retailer-specific configuration. The work includes API development, product discovery flows, knowledge-source loading, and lead capture. Retailer isolation and knowledge-loading behavior are treated as ongoing engineering concerns rather than assumed-complete features.
projects.currentFocus: Improving retailer-specific configuration, knowledge loading, retrieval isolation, and chat-to-lead workflows.

projects.title: Shopify & WordPress Product Synchronization
projects.tagline: Modernizing a legacy synchronization service from VB.NET to Python
projects.description: A product and inventory synchronization service connecting Shopify, WordPress/WooCommerce, and vendor data. Current work includes transferring established synchronization logic from VB.NET into Python, organizing reusable sync workflows, handling product and inventory rules, and building a frontend for managing and monitoring the process. An important rule is to prevent sold inventory from being uploaded even if a product is otherwise marked for upload. Public-facing examples should use fictional store and product data.
projects.currentFocus: Python migration and frontend development, while preserving existing synchronization rules and safeguards.

projects.title: Forge — Configurable Product Pricing Engine
projects.tagline: Generate consistent prices from product attributes and configurable rules
projects.description: A configurable pricing engine for products with multiple attribute combinations. The workflow models combinations such as size, metal, purity, shape, stone type, and carat weight, then applies repeatable calculation rules. Configuration and pricing generation are designed to be maintainable, with JSON-based configuration being explored to reduce unnecessary database load. Forge is the public portfolio alias; internal application names are intentionally omitted.
projects.currentFocus: Refining pricing configuration, combination generation, and calculation rules.

projects.title: Vendor Catalog & Inventory Reconciliation
projects.tagline: Normalize vendor feeds and keep product data consistent
projects.description: Data-processing and synchronization workflows for vendor catalogs and inventory feeds. The work covers SKU matching, field normalization, variant and image mapping, active/inactive filtering, upload eligibility, and repeatable batch processing across connected commerce systems.
projects.currentFocus: Improving normalization, variant mapping, and upload eligibility rules.

projects.title: WooCommerce Carrier Rate Integration
projects.tagline: Connect carrier services to an e-commerce checkout
projects.description: Shipping integration work for WooCommerce covering carrier rate requests, package quantities, unit normalization, rate selection, and checkout feedback. The implementation focuses on reliable request handling and clear UI states when rates are loading, available, or unavailable.
projects.currentFocus: Refining package handling, rate refresh behavior, and checkout notifications.

projects.title: Retailer Operations & Customer Engagement Platform
projects.tagline: A connected platform for customer conversations, messaging, catalogs, and retailer workflows
projects.description: A mature retailer-facing web platform that brings together day-to-day customer engagement and operational workflows. Its scope spans customer conversations and inbox management, outbound messages and broadcasts, SMS/MMS integrations, product and event catalog experiences, retailer settings and automated responses, appointment-related workflows, search and reporting views, and supporting database-backed tools. Engineering work includes maintaining and extending an established ASP.NET WebForms/VB.NET application, improving AJAX-driven interfaces and large data tables, integrating Twilio messaging, and connecting related e-commerce and retailer services. The portfolio describes the platform through its capabilities rather than exposing its internal product name or customer-specific details.
projects.currentFocus: Modernizing workflows, improving data-heavy interfaces and reporting, and extending integrations while preserving existing production behavior.

projects.title: Product Variant & Image Pipeline
projects.tagline: Keep product images, variants, and SKUs aligned across platforms
projects.description: A catalog-processing workflow focused on mapping product images to the correct variants, handling SKU and size data, normalizing image formats, and preparing product assets for platform synchronization. The work addresses practical edge cases such as variants missing from source schemas, image replacement behavior, and consistent file paths.
projects.currentFocus: Improving variant-to-image mapping, SKU handling, and synchronization consistency.

projects.title: Search Analytics & Reporting
projects.tagline: Turn search activity into useful operational insights
projects.description: A reporting workflow built around search-log data, including query analysis, report generation, and presenting results in an existing web application. The engineering work includes SQL-backed data retrieval and improving large-table interfaces with server-side processing and pagination.
projects.currentFocus: Developing useful reports from search logs and keeping large result sets responsive.

projects.title: Web Application Performance Monitor
projects.tagline: Capture page-load timings and make performance issues easier to investigate
projects.description: A lightweight monitoring concept for recording page lifecycle timings from an existing web application, writing structured performance records, and collecting them into a separate Python-powered view for review. The goal is to make slow navigation easier to investigate using consistent measurements rather than guesswork.
projects.currentFocus: Connecting timing capture, structured log collection, and a review interface.

projects.title: Retailer Configuration API
projects.tagline: Serve tenant-specific settings through a structured backend API
projects.description: A Python API service for extracting and serving retailer-specific configuration, with API-key verification and a database model built around store and user records. The work includes shaping configuration responses, preserving an existing settings contract, and separating retailer data so the correct settings can be loaded for each request.
projects.currentFocus: Validating retailer resolution, settings retrieval, and consistent configuration behavior.

projects.title: Retailer Notification Center
projects.tagline: Present recent, retailer-specific updates in a compact interface
projects.description: A notification-center feature concept that organizes notifications by retailer and date, with a compact panel designed to show a limited number of recent messages. The data structure and API integration are intended to keep the experience clear while preserving retailer-specific context.
projects.currentFocus: Finalizing the notification data structure and recent-message presentation.

process.title: Verify
